verdict.rationale: The only spec-related evidence is that Vanta's Auditor API SDKs are "generated from the same OpenAPI specification". That shows an internal spec exists, not that users can download it. The docs never offer a downloadable spec, and the probe found no spec at the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths (all 404). An API reference and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
